reviews.reason: Detect explicitly rejects consumer count as the classifier, but the remedy uses the number of consuming workflows. Locate ownership by the source of the contract.
Confirmed on the isolated-worker witness: flagging necessary copies is itself flagged by worker-rule-reach. Resolve the local audit prescription by proving delivery from one editable owner.
A declared initial activity and its first-step prerequisites provide a reproducible bootstrap endpoint without executing domain work.

The existing value requirement need not imply exhaustive field documentation. Name the omitted capability and the caller decision it enables; unused telemetry is not a counterexample requiring documentation.
Return-set inclusion does not account for state transition, ordering, freshness or effects. A preview cannot be replaced by a later mutating superset call.
The approval policy is stronger than the cited irreversible-change principle, which is allowed. Recognizing prior concrete authorization is a proposed policy refinement, not a contradiction.
The repair must not turn an accepted guarantee into guidance merely because enforcement is difficult. Name the requirement owner and require a deliberate scope/guarantee change.
Pre-draft literacy and validation of committed bytes have independent evidence and failure cases. Separate identities make partial closure visible.

The fact-category detector can collapse different scoped facts. The closeout entry already targets restatement; refining its audience/purpose boundary is optional rather than proof all distinct terminal artifacts are banned.
An all-pass per-item evidence ledger can establish coverage even without a parser. Its necessary observations must survive presentation compression.
Required empty representations and an evidenced zero result differ from decorative empty headings. Preserve actual consumer contracts.

Shared option labels alone do not show shared decision meaning. The entry title already supplies one-decision intent, but its answer-space test and default-frequency claim need semantic scope, authority, timing and effects.
